intro: The Meraki TV unit combines functionality with elegance, offering versatile placement, ample storage, and a high-gloss finish to redefine your entertainment space with modern sophistication.

features.title: Perfect setup for floor
features.text: Designed to adapt to your living space, this unit can be placed on the floor for a seamless look.

features.title: Ample storage with aesthetic appeal
features.text: Includes thoughtfully designed compartments for organising gadgets, accessories, and décor, ensuring a clutter-free entertainment area.

features.title: High-gloss PU finish with walnut edges
features.text: Features a premium Noce Versailles finish with high-gloss PU lamination and walnut edge detailing, adding timeless elegance to your home.

features.title: Push-to-open doors for clean design
features.text: Enjoy effortless access to storage with a push-to-open mechanism, delivering a sleek and minimalistic appearance.

features.title: Made of durable prelaminated particle board
features.text: Constructed with an 18 mm prelaminated particle board, offering strength, durability, and lasting performance.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
